title: Discovering descriptive texts
summary: Practise describing people, animals, objects and places using suitable Spanish words.
keyIdeas: Describing means explaining in detail what a person, animal, object or place is like.
Adjectives are useful for describing qualities and features.
Descriptions often follow an order, such as starting with a general picture and moving to details.

basicKnowledge: D. Reflexión sobre la lengua y sus usos en el marco de propuestas de producción y comprensión de textos orales, escritos o multimodales

activities.prompt: What is the main purpose of a descriptive text?
activities.explanation: A descriptive text explains what people, animals, objects or places are like, giving their features.
activities.hint: Think of what you do when you describe your room or pet.
options: To tell an imaginary story with characters and dialogue.
To explain in words what a living thing, object or place is like.
To give step-by-step instructions for a recipe.

activities.prompt: Descriptive texts use many adjectives to describe qualities.
activities.explanation: True. Descriptive adjectives tell us what things are like or how they are.

activities.prompt: Match each Spanish example to its type of description.
activities.explanation: We can describe places, animals, objects and people, depending on what we observe.

activities.prompt: Complete the Spanish sentence with the most suitable adjective.
activities.explanation: «espeso» describes many trees and plants close together, blocking much of the sunlight.
activities.sentence: El bosque era tan ___ que apenas entraban los rayos de sol.
options: ruidoso
salado
espeso

activities.prompt: Sort these Spanish features into appearance or character.
activities.explanation: Physical features describe the body. Character describes a person's qualities and behaviour.

activities.prompt: Find the mistake: which Spanish sentence contains a contradictory description?
activities.explanation: The same surface cannot be very dry and also completely covered by a deep lake at the same time. Those details contradict each other.
activities.hint: Compare the two descriptions of the same place: very dry and covered by a lake.
options: El parque tenía bancos de madera limpia y árboles llenos de hojas verdes.
Aisha llevaba una bufanda de lana suave porque hacía una mañana fresca.
El desierto era muy seco y estaba cubierto por un profundo lago de agua dulce.

activities.prompt: Follow this guide: introduction, appearance, character, likes. Put its steps in order.
activities.explanation: This guide begins with an introduction, then appearance and character, and finally likes or hobbies. Other ways of organising descriptions are possible.
items: Introduce the person and give their name.
Describe their general and specific physical features.
Mention their likes, hobbies or clothes.

activities.prompt: Read the Spanish description carefully and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: Descriptions of places use visual details, smells and sensations to help us imagine the space.
activities.title: El refugio de Lucas
activities.text: Lucas tiene una casita de madera construida en las ramas de un viejo roble. Sus paredes son de color castaño y el tejado tiene tejas rojas brillantes. Por fuera cuelgan macetas con geranios olorosos que alegran la entrada. Dentro hay una alfombra redonda y mullida junto a un baúl repleto de cuentos. A través de la ventana circular se contempla todo el huerto de su abuela Martina. Es un rincón silencioso, acogedor y perfecto para leer en las tardes de otoño.

questions.explanation: The text says the wooden house is built in the branches of an old oak tree.
options: On the ground in the middle of the garden.
On the roof of the village house.
In the branches of an old oak tree.

questions.prompt: Which sense is used when the geraniums are described as «olorosos»?
questions.explanation: «olorosos» refers to the flowers' smell, which we notice with our sense of smell.
options: Hearing.
Smell.
Touch.

questions.prompt: Which Spanish adjectives sum up what it feels like inside the shelter?
questions.explanation: The text ends by saying it is «silencioso» and «acogedor», and perfect for reading.
options: Silencioso y acogedor.
Peligroso y oscuro.
Frío y aburrido.

activities.prompt: Hugo loses his dog in the park. Which Spanish description would be most useful on a poster to help find it?
activities.explanation: Recognising a lost animal needs clear details of its size, colour, physical features and visible accessories.
activities.hint: Find the text giving details of the dog's appearance.
options: Perro muy simpático. Le encanta jugar con la pelota y correr mucho por el césped los domingos.
Perro mediano, pelo canela rizado, orejas caídas y collar rojo con chapa plateada. Responde al nombre de Choco.
Ayer se perdió mi perro favorito. Si lo ves avísame pronto porque lo echo mucho de menos en casa.

activities.prompt: Which descriptive device is used in «Las nubes parecían copos de algodón blanco»?
activities.explanation: It compares clouds to cotton using «parecían», helping us imagine their appearance.
activities.hint: Notice how one thing is compared with something similar.
options: A question to check the weather.
An instruction for drawing clouds step by step.
A comparison highlighting the clouds' shape and softness.
